text: For the director. Do not destroy. [1] A miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into a cave. [AA]
I Have mercy on me, God,have mercy on me.In you I seek refuge.In the shadow of your wings [2] I seek refugetill harm pass by. [AB]
I call to God Most High,to God who provides for me.
May God send help from heaven to save me,shame those who trample upon me.May God send fidelity and mercy.Selah
I must lie down in the midst of lionshungry for human prey. [AC]Their teeth are spears and arrows;their tongue, a sharpened sword. [AD]
Be exalted over the heavens, God;may your glory appear above all the earth. [AE]
II They have set a trap for my feet;my soul is bowed down;They have dug a pit before me.May they fall into it themselves! [AF]Selah
My heart is steadfast, God,my heart is steadfast.I will sing and chant praise. [AG]
Awake, my soul;awake, lyre and harp!I will wake the dawn. [3] [AH]
I will praise you among the peoples, Lord;I will chant your praise among the nations. [AI]
For your mercy towers to the heavens;your faithfulness reaches to the skies. [AJ]
Exalt yourself over the heavens, God;may your glory appear above all the earth.
